execution_context_is_delegatecall.meaning: the current execution of injectSweepAndCall runs in the intended delegatecall context where address(this) is the user's wallet/shim rather than the router contract

router_holds_user_funds.meaning: the router contract has accumulated and controls user funds, i.e. it holds a nonzero user-fund balance as a stateful custodian

claims.scope: injectSweepAndCall direct external call on TrailsRouter

preconditions.text: TrailsRouter is intended to be used via delegatecall from a smart wallet or shim contract, so address(this) resolves to the wallet/shim.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The router should remain stateless pure logic holding no long-term user funds.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The router accumulates and controls user funds, turning a stateless routing component into a stateful asset custodian.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: injectSweepAndCall is invoked on the router contract (directly or via delegatecall) as the operation under analysis.
The router is intended to be stateless pure logic that holds no long-term user funds.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the router_accumulates_user_funds impact; the stuck-funds and attacker-drain impacts are not covered by this plan.
The direct-call scenario is conditional; the report does not assert a direct invocation was observed.
Permissionlessness of injectSweepAndCall is not asserted and is not encoded.
